answer: Locks are written down in saffron, expire in grove, and ember lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 10 aliases therefore needs 186 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 2 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
